visual_review.identity: Light golden tan/ochre sandy earth with broad shallow swept bands, scattered small stone groups and sparse dry olive/ochre tufts; no tall dunes or invented scenery.
visual_review.palette_caveat: Clearly brighter and more golden/yellow than the original muted tan swatch; the four-family distinction is maintained but exact color matching is not claimed.
visual_review.density_caveat: Approximately 25-35 detail groups rather than 12-18. Broad sand bands are much cleaner and less granular than the prior red/dusty candidates, though more than 6-12 regions remain.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Tuft and stone groups often span around 10-25 world units at proposed 256 period. Low-relief bands are material coloration, not a terrain height mesh or road.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 opaque native candidate; original tone 0 is catalog-only. No scene binding or natural seamlessness claim.
